Element.attribute: Develop an appropriate approach and plan for project communications based on stakeholder’s information needs, requirements and available organizational assets.

Element.Name: define_communications_management,_HO0UYO-cEe6gj9VPFxE7ig
Element.attribute: Identifying the correct communication channels early on enables the practitioner to target the audience in the most appropriate manner, which should mean that they are more likely to listen to the practitioner's message. Communication material needs to be developed with the audience in mind. By developing tailored messages, the practitioner will get the right information through the correct mechanism to people.
To document the communications approach and plan for a project.

Element.Name: Target the audience
Element.copyright:
© 2012, 2022 EYGM Limited. All Rights Reserved.
Privacy Notice

Powered by Global Methods in conjunction with Consulting Methods
Element.attribute:
Determine the identities, responsibilities and decision rights of key stakeholders

The following table describes typical target audiences for the communication plan, along with their responsibilities:

Audience Position Description Responsibilities
Sponsor Internal Leads the group within client organization Hold ultimate responsibility for all communications within client organization
Business Lead Internal Supports the projects within the client organization Support and drive the initiative within client area of responsibility
Department Head Internal Leads the various departments within the client organization Support and drive the initiative within department
Project Manager Internal Manages a project or operational activity within client organization Adopt newly introduced project management practices in most effective manner within project teams
Board of Directors External Oversees the strategic objectives of the client organization Overall strategic planning and decision making

Element.Name: Define communication topics
Element.copyright:
© 2012, 2022 EYGM Limited. All Rights Reserved.
Privacy Notice

Powered by Global Methods in conjunction with Consulting Methods
Element.attribute:
Define topics to create awareness among stakeholders

Consider topics to communicate with stakeholders such as:

  • Scope definition (Project Charter)
  • WBS development
  • Project scheduling
  • Project estimation
  • Communications planning
  • Stakeholder identification
  • Resource management
  • Status reporting
  • Risk, management
  • Issue management
  • Quality management
  • Change control

Element.Name: Implement tools and techniques
Element.copyright:
© 2012, 2022 EYGM Limited. All Rights Reserved.
Privacy Notice

Powered by Global Methods in conjunction with Consulting Methods
Element.attribute:
Implement tools and techniques that will publicize processes and tools to project teams.

Consider a variety of tools and techniques to communicate effectively.



Tools and Techniques Description
Presentations Face to face sessions coordinated and presented by specialized project personnel
Training Sessions Formal training sessions conducted on relevant project areas
Discussions Focus group discussions among small groups of staff members conducted by the project team members
E-mail or voicemail Concise messages provided to communicate project related reminders, information or concerns
Newsletter A periodic newsletter can be distributed on a regular basis to address a wide range of project issues, practices and topics for stakeholders
Company website Utilize the client's company intranet to disseminate project awareness information, best practices and other documents, as well as provide up-to-date status on programs.  This is an optimum channel to post information of an immediate nature

Element.Name: Develop a communications calendar
Element.copyright:
© 2012, 2022 EYGM Limited. All Rights Reserved.
Privacy Notice

Powered by Global Methods in conjunction with Consulting Methods
Element.attribute:
Develop a communications calendar that will permit structured, regular dialog with key stakeholders regarding project performance.

The communication calendar documents communication methods (media), frequency and the target audience. It also designates the person(s) responsible for creating and delivering communications. The communications calendar is a “living” document that is revised according to project needs.
